variations.prompt: Flat 2D storybook illustration in a warm, friendly children's-book style: clean smooth vector-like shapes, soft gradients, gentle paper texture, rounded characters with expressive faces, consistent thick-free line style, warm palette of terracotta, teal, mustard yellow and cream. Peruvian everyday family. Character model sheet on a plain off-white background: four characters standing side by side, full body, front view, evenly spaced, same art style, no text, no labels, no logos. From left to right: (1) Papá: 35-year-old Peruvian man, short black hair, thick mustache, blue polo shirt, jeans, big expressive eyebrows, slightly nervous kind face. (2) Mamá: 33-year-old woman, black hair in a ponytail, terracotta blouse, calm confident smile. (3) Niño: 8-year-old boy, big round eyes, bowl haircut, mustard-yellow hoodie, curious face. (4) Abuela: 70-year-old grandmother, grey hair in a neat bun, round glasses, green cardigan, warm knowing smile, slightly shorter than the others.
